title: The 14th Meeting of the Planning and Environment Committee
also_present: The meeting was called to order at 1:02 PM
it being noted that  S. Hillier was in remote attendance.

content.string: That it BE NOTED that no pecuniary interests were disclosed.

motion_texts.string: That, pursuant to section 27.6 of the Council Procedure By-law, a change in order of the Planning and Environment Committee Agenda BE APPROVED, to provide for Item 3.1 in Stage 3, Scheduled Items, to be considered before Stage 2, Consent.
That Items 2.1 and 2.2, BE APPROVED.
That, on the recommendation of the Director, Planning and Development, the staff report dated September 21, 2026, related to the Quarterly Heritage Report – Q3 2026, BE RECEIVED.

That, on the recommendation of the Director, Planning and Development, the following actions be taken with respect to the application from Tridon Properties Ltd. relating to the properties located at 1604 VanDusen Court:

a)    the proposed by-law as appended to the staff report dated September 21, 2026, as Appendix “A”, BE INTRODUCED at the Municipal Council meeting to be held on October 14, 2026, to deem Block 71, Registered Plan No. 33M-588, formerly in the Township of London, and now in the City of London, County of Middlesex, not to be a registered plan of subdivision for the purposes of subsection 50(4) of the Planning Act; and,

b)    the City Clerk BE DIRECTED to provide notice of the by-law passing and undertake registration of the Deeming By-law, in accordance with the provisions in subsections 50(28) and 50(29) of the Planning Act.

That, on the recommendation of the Director, Planning and Development, the following actions be taken with respect to the staff report dated September 21, 2026, related to the Heritage Property Tax Relief Program:

That, on the recommendation of the Director, Planning and Development, the following actions be taken with respect to the staff report dated September 21, 2026, related to the Heritage Property Tax Relief Program:
a)    the above-noted staff report BE RECEIVED; and,
b)    the implementation of a Heritage Property Tax Relief Program BE REFERRED for consideration as part of the 2027-2031 Strategic Plan and 2028-2031 Multi-Year Budget process;.
That the motion BE AMENDED to add a new part c), as follows:
c)    the Civic Administration BE DIRECTED to include, as part of the referral to the Multi Year Budget, a proposed structure or format based on the model used by the Town of Collingwood.
That the motion, as amended, BE APPROVED.

7.title: Designation Under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act for the Heritage Listed Property at 255 Delacourt Road

motion_texts.string: That, on the recommendation of the Director, Planning and Development, the following actions be taken with respect to the staff report dated September 21, 2026, related to the heritage listed property at 255 Delacourt Road:

a)    notice BE GIVEN under the provisions of Section 29(3) of the Ontario Heritage Act, R.S.O. 1990, C.O. 18, of the Municipal Council’s intention to designate the property at 255 Delacourt Road to be of cultural heritage value or interest for the reasons outlined in the above-noted staff report as Appendix E; and,

b)    should no objections be received to the Municipal Council’s notice of intention to designate, a by-law to designate the property at 255 Delacourt Road to be of cultural heritage value or interest for the reasons outlined in the above-noted staff report as Appendix E, BE INTRODUCED at a future meeting of Municipal Council immediately

following the end of the 30-day appeal period;

it being noted that should an appeal to the Municipal Council’s notice of intention to designate be received, the City Clerk will refer the appeal to the Ontario Land Tribunal; 



it being further noted that the delegation request from J. Rosenzweig, with respect to this matter, was received.
That the delegation request from J. Rosenzweig, in attendance of the Planning and Environment Committee, be heard at this time.

it being noted that should an appeal to the Municipal Council’s notice of intention to designate be received, the City Clerk will refer the appeal to the Ontario Land Tribunal.
